$comment: Model weight provenance registry — enforced by tests/unit/licence-policy.test.ts.
1. licence must be on the commercial-use allowlist (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause, CC0-1.0).
Model WEIGHTS are licensed separately from inference CODE; both must be checked.
2. source must be the canonical https URL for the exact artefact (not a mirror, not a
project homepage). Kokoro's maintainers warn that similarly-named sites are scam mirrors.
3. revision must be a pinned commit/tag, never a floating branch.
4. sha256 + bytes must come from the artefact actually fetched, never from a model card.
5. verifiedOn is the date the licence and hash were last confirmed against the source.
The 'weights' array stays EMPTY until a download is actually performed and hashed.
Registering a hash that was never computed would be a fabricated integrity claim, so no
placeholder rows are pre-populated. Candidates are tracked in 'candidates' instead, which is
human-readable provenance with no integrity assertion.

candidates.licenceScope: weights and inference code both Apache-2.0
candidates.notes: 82M params, CPU-capable near real-time, 54 voices. No Kiswahili. Download only from the canonical HF org (hexgrad); maintainers warn of scam mirrors.
CTranslate2 reimplementation of Whisper. Handles English well and Kiswahili acceptably; Kenyan-accented English and code-switched Sheng are the known gap.
Cuts STT cost by endpointing utterances before recognition.
1024-dim, multilingual incl. Kiswahili/English cross-lingual. Target dimension for the AiKnowledgeChunk design.

candidates.licenceScope: weights Apache-2.0 with explicit patent grant
candidates.notes: Chosen as the self-host baseline specifically to avoid the Llama naming rule and the Gemma prohibited-use passthrough. Requires a GPU tier; not justified on cost, only on data residency.

MIT permits commercial use, but there are no upstream fixes. Includes a built-in watermark that must not be stripped. Shipping it would also enable voice cloning, which JATA should not offer (fraud/impersonation exposure).

rejected.reason: Coqui Public Model Licence — non-commercial weights; vendor shut down 2024 so no licence can be purchased
MIT code but official checkpoints are CC-BY-NC-4.0
Maintained successor is GPL-3.0-or-later; per-voice licences vary and the project grants none
Llama Community Licence requires 'Built with Llama' display and a 'Llama' prefix on derived model names — contaminates product naming
Gemma Terms of Use require passing Google's Prohibited Use Policy downstream as an enforceable provision in customer agreements
Real-time voice conversion enables impersonation; risk exceeds any product value
